# Freeze store integrity maintenance

Ensure the `TextFileBasedViolationStore` maintains the integrity of its `stored.rules` index and files.

Setting `default.integrity` to `repair` will check the index and folder as they are on disk during initialization, even if the same folder was initialized before. Defaulting to `ignore` which checks nothing.

If an entry points to a path that is not a regular file directly within the folder, it is broken. This also applies if the file name is not a valid path.

If an entry is not broken and its file has no violations it is resolved. Files that only contain line breaks are also resolved.

Entries that point to the same file name are shared, even if nothing exists with that name. If multiple entries point to the same regular file they are also shared. Including through a symbolic or hard link. Even if that file is outside the folder.

The `TextFileBasedViolationStore` will not touch any shared entries or files that no entry points to. If an entry is shared and anything else it will remain shared.

When set to `repair` broken entries will be discarded without touching whatever they point to.

When set to `repair` resolved entries and the file they point to will be discarded. If a resolved entry is a symbolic link the file it points to will be deleted as well.

If using `repair` and saving no violations for a known rule it will forget the rule. Its entry will be removed and its file as well. Unless another entry is sharing that file. In which case only the entry will be removed. Even if it points outside the folder. If using `repair` and saving no violations for an unknown rule nothing will be saved.

If it cannot delete the file of a rule it is forgetting it will fail to save and leave the entry.

### Summary of Changes

1. **Configuration and Lifecycle ([`TextFileBasedViolationStore`](file:///app/archunit/src/main/java/com/tngtech/archunit/library/freeze/TextFileBasedViolationStore.java))**:
   - Added configuration property `default.integrity` (defaults to `"ignore"`, checks nothing; supports `"repair"`).
   - In [`initialize(Properties)`](file:///app/archunit/src/main/java/com/tngtech/archunit/library/freeze/TextFileBasedViolationStore.java#L131-L144), when `default.integrity=repair`, reloads index and folder state from disk and executes integrity maintenance even if the folder was initialized before.

2. **Classification of Entries**:
   - **Shared**: Entries pointing to the same file name (even if the file does not exist) or pointing to the same regular file (including via symbolic or hard links, even if outside the folder) are classified as shared. Shared entries and files not pointed to by any entry are never touched during repair.
   - **Broken**: Non-shared entries pointing to paths that are not regular files directly within the folder (or with invalid path names, directories, non-existent files, broken symlinks, or symlinks to directories) are broken. When set to `repair`, broken entries are discarded from `stored.rules` without touching their targets.
   - **Resolved**: Non-broken entries whose file contains no violations (or only line breaks) are resolved. When set to `repair`, resolved entries are removed from `stored.rules` and their violation files are deleted. If the entry is a symbolic link, both the target file and the symbolic link itself are deleted.

3. **Rule Forgetting During `save` with `repair`**:
   - In [`save(ArchRule, List<String>)`](file:///app/archunit/src/main/java/com/tngtech/archunit/library/freeze/TextFileBasedViolationStore.java#L170-L198), saving no violations for an unknown rule with `repair` saves nothing (no files or index entries created).
   - Saving no violations for a known rule forgets the rule: its entry is removed from `stored.rules` and its file is deleted (even if outside the folder), unless another entry shares that file (in which case only the entry is removed).
   - If deleting the violation file fails, a [`StoreUpdateFailedException`](file:///app/archunit/src/main/java/com/tngtech/archunit/library/freeze/StoreUpdateFailedException.java) is thrown and the entry is left intact in `stored.rules`.

4. **Exception Handling**:
   - Added `StoreUpdateFailedException(String message, Throwable cause)` in [`StoreUpdateFailedException`](file:///app/archunit/src/main/java/com/tngtech/archunit/library/freeze/StoreUpdateFailedException.java) for clean cause propagation during file deletion failures.

5. **Testing**:
   - Added comprehensive tests to [`TextFileBasedViolationStoreTest`](file:///app/archunit/src/test/java/com/tngtech/archunit/library/freeze/TextFileBasedViolationStoreTest.java) covering ignore mode, broken entry removal without touching targets, resolved file and symlink target deletion, shared entry preservation across symlinks and hardlinks, re-initialization repair, unknown rule no-op, known rule forgetting, shared file retention, and failure handling when files cannot be deleted.
